select s.mec_id ,s.campus_id,school_name,students_phone,s.id, student_name , ct.remaining_number, ct.total_number, s.register_time, s.create_time from bd_student s left join bd_course_time ct on s.id = ct.student_id and ct.course_id = #{classCourseId} where s.id IN ( SELECT student_id FROM bd_student_class WHERE class_id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC ) AND s.is_delete = 0
and student_name like CONCAT('%',#{studentName},'%')

SELECT count(id) FROM bd_student WHERE id IN ( SELECT student_id FROM bd_student_class WHERE class_id = #{classId} and is_delete = 0) AND is_delete = 0
and student_name like CONCAT('%',#{studentName},'%')

SELECT sc.mec_id, sc.campus_id, sc.student_id, stu.students_phone, stu.student_name, bc.class_name, min.wechat_subscribe_openid, cou.id course_id, cou.course_name course_name, cam.name campus_name, mec.name mec_name FROM bd_student_class sc LEFT JOIN bd_student stu on sc.student_id = stu.id LEFT JOIN bd_class bc on sc.class_id = bc.id LEFT JOIN bd_course cou on bc.class_course_id = cou.id LEFT JOIN min_login min on stu.students_phone = min.phone LEFT JOIN bd_campus cam on sc.campus_id = cam.id LEFT JOIN bd_mechanism mec on sc.mec_id = mec.id WHERE sc.class_id = #{classId} AND sc.is_delete = 0 AND student_id NOT IN ( SELECT vac.student_id FROM bd_ask_leave vac LEFT JOIN bd_student stu ON vac.student_id = stu.id WHERE vac.type = 1 AND ( (#{clsEndTime} BETWEEN vac.start_time AND off_time) OR (#{clsStartTime} > vac.start_time AND #{clsEndTime} < off_time) OR (#{clsStartTime} BETWEEN vac.start_time AND off_time)) AND vac.is_delete = 0)
SELECT stu.student_name FROM bd_student_class sc LEFT JOIN bd_student stu on sc.student_id = stu.id WHERE sc.class_id = #{classId} AND sc.is_delete = 0
